good: You work with Chinese dialogue and Chinese video platforms.
You want first-frame or reference-image prompts alongside video prompts.
consider: You need direct YouTube or TikTok URL analysis; upload a file instead.
You need anonymous use: registration is required.

faq.a: Registration includes trial time. After that, prepaid packs are billed by the video’s duration; the official pricing page says failed analyses do not consume time.
The FAQ lists MP4, MOV, WebM and M4V, a maximum of 500 MB per file and clips up to 10 minutes.

faq.q: Can I paste a YouTube or TikTok link?
faq.a: The FAQ says these are not directly supported. Download an authorized copy and use the local upload instead.

faq.q: How does it handle uploaded video?
faq.a: According to the FAQ, the video is removed after analysis, while the text result remains in account history. This is an official policy statement, not a privacy audit.

faq.q: What is the difference between the output formats?
faq.a: All-in-one reference produces asset references plus video prompts; first-frame focuses on the opening image; the combined option includes both. Choose the workflow your target model accepts.
